question: P can do one-fourth piece of some work in 18 days. She completed 37.5% of that work and left it. Q complete the remaining work in 40 days. Working together they will complete ( {frac{{17}}{{48}}} ) part of the same work in:
solution:
**Given:**

P can do one-fourth piece of some work in 18 days.

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency of the workers × time taken by them

**Calculation:**

P can do one-fourth piece of the work in 18 days

So, he will do the complete the work in 18 × 4 = 72 days

Now, 37.5% of the work has been completed by P
